name: Catenanuova (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of purple-red (porpora) and silver-grey, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Catenanuova (a book and a figure on light blue) within branches, with the inscription COMUNE DI CATENANUOVA in white arched above.
history: Municipal flag of Catenanuova, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office. The arms and gonfalone were granted by decree of the President of the Republic on 7 April 2003.
